note: Names, descriptions and grades checked against KeenGamer and Push Square (Nov 2026); both agree on all 55. Methods are written in our own words from those guides and are cited per trophy. Where the published guides have not confirmed a method, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, side stories next, then collectibles, then the long grinds, and the platinum is the last sound you hear.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy, unmissable — just play through to the end of the chapter. Do the balcony meditation with Lucia before you leave Chapter 1, though: it is tied to the one potentially missable trophy (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable. Bank vault robberies open up during this chapter, so start them when the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission — it unlocks as you play through the campaign and there is nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission — it unlocks as you play through the campaign and there is nothing extra to do.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission — it unlocks as you play through the campaign and there is nothing extra to do.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is a story mission — it unlocks as you play through the campaign and there is nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is a story mission at Vice City International Airport — it unlocks as you play through the campaign and there is nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story mission — it unlocks as you play through the campaign and there is nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion — it appears after the story). You do not need literally everything: for example only 15 of the 18 card sets, 300 of the 397 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges and 100 of the 125 flamingos. Work the checklist in free roam after the story; most of it overlaps with the other trophies, so it is the last big job before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts come in four kinds — Stunt Jumps (130), Under the Bridges (202), Knife Flights (40) and Base Jumps (25) — 397 in total, so you need just over half. Find them on the map under Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts. Note that 100% completion wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. The game counts a type the first time you start it, and the Activities tab on the map lists them — work down that list (fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool and the other pastimes are among them) and the trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some are locked until you meet conditions shown on the map. Track progress under Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee. Find them under Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. You also need all 42 Drone Time Trials for 100% completion, so run the time trials at the same locations while you are there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count — 20 distinct race events. Track them under Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating can be raised with Mod Shop upgrades. 100% completion wants 30 of 40 races won, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked area — hijack one if you need to — and fish until you land a parrotfish big enough to beat him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish any one arcade cabinet game. 100% completion asks you to play all four video games, so try the rest while you are there.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Finish Andy's whole mission strand; the trophy pops at the end of it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, Maritime Disputes. Finish Kenton's whole mission strand; the trophy pops when that mission ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission, Hometown Heroes. Finish Billy's whole mission strand; the trophy pops when that mission ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions show as purple icons (and black icons with pink letters) on the map. There are more strands than eight, so you can skip the ones you dislike — do them as they appear during and after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Finish all of Randy's missions — his strand includes fetching vehicles from a wish list, so keep an eye out for the cars he wants while you drive around Leonida.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Finish all of Tyrone's missions; his strand involves finding Kitty Litter Labs, which Push Square maps in a separate guide.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. THE missable one: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen when she mentions meditation, follow her to the balcony and accept. Do it before leaving Chapter 1 — it becomes unavailable later, and guides warn it may be required for the trophy. Other spots are marked on the map (Touch Pad, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida); a meditation counts once the final 'zen' animation plays. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Note: whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is strictly required is still unconfirmed — do it anyway.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand gives you target animals to track down — take the unique one he asks for. His Target Deck objectives (15 in total) also count toward 100% completion, so keep hunting past this one.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game; finish any three. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward the sets. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. 100% completion wants 15 sets, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up) and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — Push Square lists 31 landmark, 35 curiosity and 23 sculpture spots, plus No Flusher tags, so there are more than enough. Scan as you travel; track progress under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are in-game feats listed under Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges — 80 in total, so you can skip the 30 hardest. 100% completion wants 70, so keep going past 50. Many complete naturally while you chase the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight until the wanted level clears. One escape route reported by the guides is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police and the helicopter struggle to follow you along the tracks.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while your partner is with you and keep the same wanted level through all three — do not let it clear between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside it or scan it with WAiNK. It happens naturally through the story; track progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles. 100% completion wants 200 base-model vehicles out of 277, so keep scanning after this pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before a fight, build up your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline, then trigger Combat Focus in a firefight and drop five enemies before it runs out — an assault rifle helps.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a departing passenger aircraft at Vice City International Airport and take off with it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Find a Rhino at a military site, take it, and use its cannon in a fight — the trophy is about driving the tank into action, not just sitting in it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out without raising the alarm — plan the approach, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone spots you. A loud smash-and-grab will not count.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults open up during Chapter 4 through the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'. 100% completion wants all 8 vaults, so keep going past five. Note: most published lists grade this one Silver; Push Square's guide currently lists it as Bronze.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, take its cargo and lose the wanted level — the escape is part of the trophy, so do not stop once the truck is open.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail through every named area until the map is fully uncovered. The exact area count is not confirmed in the published guides, so treat the in-game map as the authority — fill in every blank patch.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are nine gangs in Leonida; hit at least one illegal operation for each of them. 100% completion wants all 39 gang operations, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description points at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed in the published guides yet — head to the Ocean Beach waterfront, order a drink with a view, and check your trophy list. Method unconfirmed: do not rely on a single reported spot until the guides agree.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description suggests driving a car out through a showroom's glass front, but no published guide has confirmed the exact showroom or trigger yet. Method unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. KeenGamer reports the method as stealing the three key valuables inside the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and escaping; Push Square lists only the trophy hint, so treat the method as reported but not yet widely confirmed.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. KeenGamer reports this as maximising the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia; other guides have read the same hint differently (one reads it as maximising body fat), so the method is disputed — work on Strength for both characters first and check the trophy list. Method disputed / unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — robberies, enemy encounters and other criminal acts all feed it. It builds up naturally over a full playthrough; check the profile under Progress and keep playing the criminal life if you are short.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Games.gg — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This hidden trophy's unlock method has not been confirmed in any published guide yet — the description hints at failing something once and succeeding on the second try, but that is a guess, not a method. Method unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy with no confirmed unlock method in the published guides yet. It reads like an encounter with something strange in Leonida — keep an eye on guide updates rather than chasing a rumoured trigger. Method unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed; one reading reported by PowerPyx (via GTA Vice City Hub) is knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds. Treat that as unconfirmed until the guides agree.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence Marked Bills through your contacts until the cumulative total reaches $250,000. It also counts toward 100% completion, so it comes naturally if you fence everything you steal instead of hoarding it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending counts — clothes, food, weapons, car upgrades. Find shops under Touch Pad, Style. It adds up fast once you start buying garages and gear, so do not grind it early.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages, $160,000 in total, each with one parking spot: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register a vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — you need a free parking spot, so buy garages first if you are full. Do it for 10 different vehicles; Scooter Bros will then deliver them to you, fully repaired, for a small fee.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
